candidates.title: Completion needs a checkable handoff
candidates.external_argument: Three synthetic examples ask what evidence accompanies an agent completion claim.
candidates.counterargument: Exploratory work can use provisional labels when consequences are low.
candidates.buyer_question: What check should accompany a claimed completed task?
candidates.concrete_problem: Agent completion labels can hide unfinished acceptance checks.
candidates.useful_consequence: A reviewer can decide whether to accept or request correction.
candidates.owner_position: Ask for a checkable result and retain the correction trail.
candidates.proof_needed: The owner must supply a public-safe real example before drafting.
candidates.differentiation: Discuss the acceptance handoff, not an abstract agent benchmark.
candidates.format_why: Owner proof and wording need review.
hooks: What does done mean when an agent says it?
Can the next reviewer check the result?
candidates.hook_basis_detail: Which public-safe acceptance handoff can the owner show?
disqualifications: Synthetic examples cannot substantiate a public claim
